findings.title: Charge temporary owner-map insertion and the consumed-group pass
findings.description: The initial owner loop charges its owner visit, but groups.insert performs a new ordered-map insertion without the existing log_cost(groups.len(),b) tree-work charge. The later for(id,(bounds,faces)) in groups pass also processes each owner group without a b.step(1) visit. Other new point/plane maps and source grouping get_mut use explicit tree prices. Omitting these actual new visits understates full certificate-construction work under the unchanged operation cap.
findings.requestedCorrection: Keep the initial owner visit. Add existing tree-work pricing for each actual groups insertion and one actual consumed-group visit before its certification/transfer work. Do not precharge unexecuted iterations,change unit prices,suppress/refactor away assertions or raise caps. Retain complete-build work comparison with all added charges.

findings.title: Charge the strict box predicate separately from the owner visit
findings.description: strictly_covers_admitted charges one owner-loop visit, then performs a distinct three-dimensional strict containment predicate without charging the existing whole-box operation. Bounds::meets and Bounds::contains each charge one operation for the entire box test,not one per axis. Queries rejected by this new box test currently pay only the owner visit and no plane work,so this real new predicate is omitted from the operation ledger.
findings.requestedCorrection: Retain the owner-loop step and admit one separate operation immediately before the foreign-owner strict box predicate,using the existing whole-box price. Preserve strict inequalities and original short-circuit behavior; do not introduce per-axis repricing. Add a focused refusal guard for a foreign facet failing this box test with only the owner-visit budget available,while retaining all old assertions and caps.
